description: This file defines models and fetcher classes for SEC filings, including query parameters, data structures, and methods for downloading and parsing SEC filing documents.

classes.name: SecFilingQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for SEC filings, including URL and cache usage.

classes.name: SecFilingData
classes.description: Represents the structured data of an SEC filing, including document URLs and metadata.

classes.name: SecBaseFiling
classes.description: Base class for SEC filing data, including methods for downloading and parsing filing documents.

classes.name: SecFilingFetcher
classes.description: Fetcher class for retrieving SEC filing data asynchronously and transforming raw data into structured models.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Transforms input parameters into a SecFilingQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously extracts raw SEC filing data from the SEC website.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw data into a SecFilingData model.
